reviewRules: Do not write Firestore updates from this packet.
Shell thickness must be numeric in millimeters.
Do not use shell thickness confidence as a substitute for actual shell thickness.
Do not infer thickness from shell construction, shell material, line name, hoop type, or era alone.
Line-level promotion requires source evidence that clearly applies across the listed models/era.
